# Halation

The red-orange glow around bright lights on film, where light bounced off the film base and exposed the red layer again.

<EffectDemo effect="halation" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { halation } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/halation';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(halation({ preset: 'film' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.intensity = 0.6`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type      | Default     | Range | Description                                              |
| ----------- | --------- | ----------- | ----- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `intensity` | number    | `0.6`       | 0 – 3 | Strength of the glow.                                    |
| `threshold` | number    | `0.8`       | 0 – 8 | Linear brightness above which highlights halate.         |
| `knee`      | number    | `0.6`       | 0 – 1 | Softness of the threshold.                               |
| `radius`    | number    | `0.35`      | 0 – 1 | Spread of the glow; halation is tighter than bloom.      |
| `levels`    | integer   | `4`         | 2 – 6 | Blur levels; fewer keep the glow close to the highlight. |
| `tint`      | hex color | `'#ff4a1c'` |       | Color of the glow.                                       |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset   | Settings                            |
| -------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `film`   | `intensity: 0.5`, `radius: 0.3`     |
| `strong` | `intensity: 1.4`, `threshold: 0.6`  |
| `tight`  | `radius: 0.15`, `levels: 3`         |
| `golden` | `tint: '#ff9a2e'`, `intensity: 0.8` |

Apply one with `halation({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Lens & camera · tracked as story X4.9 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass. It also renders its own intermediate passes before the merged pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 7.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/halation`, including the shared effect runtime.

Original implementation (MIT). References: Film halation as a tight, red-tinted bloom of luminance, using the bloom chain.
